title: JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1: An Industrial-Scale LLM/VLM-Centric Solution for Item Understanding, Management, and Applications
title_zh: JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC) V1：面向商品理解、管理与应用的工业级 LLM/VLM 中心化解决方案
abstract_en: JD.com, one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms, serves over 700 million active users and millions of merchants, with a catalog of tens of billions of SKUs. At this scale, high-quality, structured item knowledge underpins a better consumer experience, lower management costs, and higher operational efficiency-yet producing and serving it poses three industrial-scale challenges: fast-emerging concepts, high-quality knowledge production for massive SKUs, and diverse downstream requirements. To address these challenges, we present the JD Oxygen AI Item Center (Oxygen AIIC), an industrial-scale platform built on LLMs/VLMs for item-knowledge production and service. Oxygen AIIC is built around four core pillars: (i) ontology engineering driven by efficient human-AI collaboration, which supports the dynamic evolution and agile expansion of an ontology with millions of entries; (ii) a "Semantic Search then Discrimination"(S2D) knowledge identification architecture that, combined with throughput improvement strategies, enables scalable, extensible, and high-throughput AI Item Library production for tens of billions of SKUs; (iii) self-evolving item-understanding LLMs/VLMs that improve in a stable and controllable manner, enabling knowledge production with 94.2% precision and 82.8% recall; and (iv) a unified item tunnel that serves as the data and service hub. Oxygen AIIC now covers tens of thousands of JD categories and processes hundreds of millions of item updates per day on Huawei Ascend NPUs. It has accumulated hundreds of billions of item-knowledge assets. Deployed across core business scenarios-including search, recommendation, operations, category planning-Oxygen AIIC has delivered measurable gains at scale. Search-traffic coverage reaches 80.4%, item-information quality issues drop by 37%, the automated fill rate of core attributes during item listing exceeds 80%.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍 JD.com 的 JD Oxygen AI Item Center（Oxygen AIIC）V1，这是一个以 LLM/VLM 为核心的工业级商品知识生产与服务平台，面向数百亿 SKU、数百万商家和超 7 亿活跃用户的大规模电商场景。针对快速涌现的新概念、海量 SKU 的高质量知识生产、以及多样化下游业务需求三大挑战，Oxygen AIIC 构建了四个核心模块：基于高效人机协同的 ontology engineering，用于支撑百万级条目的动态演进；“Semantic Search then Discrimination”（S2D）知识识别架构，结合吞吐优化策略，实现可扩展、高吞吐的 AI Item Library 生产；可自进化的商品理解 LLMs/VLMs，以稳定可控方式提升知识抽取能力；以及统一商品通道（unified item tunnel），作为数据与服务中枢。系统已覆盖 JD 数万个品类，每天在 Huawei Ascend NPUs 上处理数亿商品更新，沉淀数千亿商品知识资产，并在搜索、推荐、运营、类目规划等核心场景带来规模化收益。
key_points_zh: 提出 Oxygen AIIC：面向 JD.com 超大规模电商商品知识生产与服务的工业级平台，服务数百亿 SKU 和多种核心业务场景。
通过人机协同 ontology engineering 支撑百万级本体条目的动态扩展，解决电商中新概念、新属性、新类目快速涌现的问题。
设计 S2D（Semantic Search then Discrimination）知识识别架构，并结合吞吐优化，实现面向数百亿 SKU 的高吞吐、可扩展 AI Item Library 生产。
构建自进化商品理解 LLMs/VLMs，在可控迭代中达到 94.2% precision 和 82.8% recall，用于大规模商品知识抽取。
系统已在搜索、推荐、运营、类目规划等场景落地：搜索流量覆盖率达 80.4%，商品信息质量问题下降 37%，核心属性自动填充率超过 80%。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant industrial LLM/VLM item-understanding system with substantial catalog-scale deployment and measurable commerce benefits.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的工业级LLM/VLM商品理解系统，具备大规模部署和可量化的电商收益。
